name: Plugin catalog
tagline: 26 ready plugins for providers apps call every day, installed one at a time or a whole collection at once.
point: the provider's host on :8443, Test CA trusted

capabilities.title: Install in one call
capabilities.text: install_plugin adds a plugin to the environment; plugin=empty starts one that records.

capabilities.title: Collections
capabilities.text: Brazil ICP-Brasil, Logistics & fiscal, Payments & notifications, Workplace & dev tools: install_collection adds what is missing.

capabilities.title: Look before installing
capabilities.text: get_catalog_plugin shows routes, pages it draws, synthetic people, situations to provoke, permissions and files.

capabilities.title: Find and filter
capabilities.text: By words, region (Global or Brazil), browser pages or collection; cards say installed here and update available.

capabilities.title: Yours to edit
capabilities.text: An installed plugin is plain YAML: route editor, set_answer, or put_plugin with a version check (409 on conflict).

capabilities.title: Import your own
capabilities.text: import_plugin reads a folder, a .zip or a git URL (path, ref) and checks it; install_import installs it.

capabilities.title: Validated with line numbers
capabilities.text: validate_plugin returns schema and expression errors with line numbers before anything is saved.

capabilities.title: Stripe in test mode
capabilities.text: PaymentIntents with test payment methods such as pm_card_chargeDeclined, Idempotency-Key replays and Stripe-signed webhooks.

capabilities.title: Brazil signing stack
capabilities.text: Datavalid identity checks, BirdID authorize pages, ViDaaS push approvals and REST PKI PAdES signatures, with synthetic CPFs.

callouts.title: Region
callouts.text: Filter Global or Brazil, set by the plugin's author.

callouts.title: A collection
callouts.text: A pack of plugins for one kind of app; add the rest in one call.

callouts.title: Installed here
callouts.text: Each card says whether this environment has it, and its version.

callouts.title: What it covers
callouts.text: Routes and the answers you can give, before you install.

callouts.title: Add to the environment
callouts.text: Installs the plugin YAML; point the app at it or use the real host name.

excerpts.title: An installed plugin: named answers and data

callouts.title: Named answers
callouts.text: Each situation the provider can answer, with its status, ready to force.

callouts.title: Body template
callouts.text: Filled from the request and the state, in the provider's own shape.

callouts.title: Force for the next calls
callouts.text: The same as force_answer: ends by itself after N calls.

callouts.title: Data the answers read
callouts.text: Synthetic CPFs with their state; set_data replaces or appends rows.

callouts.title: Used by
callouts.text: The route and decide step that gives this answer.

provoke.name: Token used twice
provoke.what: reCAPTCHA answers timeout-or-duplicate for a reused token

provoke.name: Bot score
provoke.what: reCAPTCHA scores 0.1 for a token starting with bot

provoke.name: Turnstile fails
provoke.what: A token starting with fail fails the check

provoke.name: Face mismatch
provoke.what: Datavalid says the selfie is someone else

provoke.name: Free tier exhausted
provoke.what: ReceitaWS answers 429 after 3 calls a minute

provoke.name: Expired person certificate
provoke.what: A cloud certificate that expired yesterday, in every plugin

provoke.name: Push rejected
provoke.what: ViDaaS push approval rejected or timed out on the phone

provoke.name: Signature step fails
provoke.what: REST PKI start or finish answers 422 or 500

provoke.name: Any plugin down
provoke.what: 503, timeout or reset on any installed plugin

advantages.title: Written once, by someone
advantages.text: A person who knows the provider writes the plugin; everyone else installs it in one call.

advantages.title: Situations named
advantages.text: Each plugin lists what it can answer and provoke, named for what it means.

advantages.title: Synthetic data built in
advantages.text: People, CPFs, CNPJs and accounts at acme and globex; never a real person.

advantages.title: Safe by default
advantages.text: A plugin cannot reach the network or the disk unless it declares it; pages are fields, not scripts.

agent.prompt: Set up the payments and notifications providers for this environment and show me what Stripe can provoke.
steps: routes, webhooks, situations: card_declined, missing_amount, 429, 503, timeout
tools: The catalog with collections, filters and what is installed
Installs a plugin, or an empty one that records
Reads your plugin from a folder, .zip or git URL
Errors with line numbers before saving
Removes a plugin from the environment

notes: The catalog lives in engine/plugins/ in the repository; contributions must pass validate_plugin and use synthetic data.
